differences: The paper reports differential adaptation, its SDs and the t-tests in mels; they reproduce exactly from F1 in Hz (the authors' distF1, F1 minus the mean of the word's last 10 Baseline repetitions), so those numbers are in Hz. The shift itself was applied in mels.
Experiment 3: the paper analyses 19 of 21 participants; the shared file has 20, including one the authors' code drops after the fact (sp726), whom the de-identified codes do not let us mark.
